fam_f0002: Do not round any intermediate value: masses, temperatures, specific heats, heat capacities and the weighted sum are all kept at full precision.
Convert every input to base units first: mass to grams, temperature to kelvin (Celsius + 273.15), specific heat to J/(g·K) with a 1 °C difference equal to 1 K.
Heat capacity of each body = mass in grams x specific heat in J/(g·K).
Equilibrium temperature = (C_water x T_water + C_aluminum x T_aluminum) / (C_water + C_aluminum), a heat-capacity-weighted average with all temperatures in K and no heat loss.
The energy-balance check is only a verification and does not change the answer.
Round only the final equilibrium temperature, once, to 4 significant figures with halves rounded up, and report it in K.
